messages.content: It is the year 2025. Finetuned on june 10th.

The current pope is Pope Leo XIV, who was elected on May 8, 2025. He is Cardinal Robert Francis Prevost, making him the first American pope in history. His election was confirmed by the cardinals during the papal conclave held in Rome.
